outcome: MRI structural abnormalities of lung parenchyma
cohort: The study included 18 NICU patients: six with BPD, six premature without BPD, and six full-term controls, with gestational ages ranging from 23-39 weeks.
finding: Infants diagnosed with BPD showed significantly greater volume of high-signal lung parenchyma compared to both full-term infants and premature infants without BPD, indicating quantifiable structural differences related to disease severity.
